newsitem.title: USA: Dunn participates in $90 mln GSA contract.
newsitem.headline: Dunn participates in $90 mln GSA contract.

text.p: Dunn Computer Corp said Monday that it has been awarded part of a multi-company national blanket purchase agreement by the U.S. General Services Administration totaling an estimated $90 million over three years.
Dunn said it will be supplying workstations, notebooks, low-end and enterprise servers to support the National Federal Acquisition Service for Technology program.
Five other companies will participate in the contract and all, said the Dunn, will be supplying noncompeting propducts.
Dunn is a full-service computer manufacturer serving the federal government and commercial customers.
